message.reasoning_content: We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The facts: The defendant Wang introduced others to issue false VAT invoices (虚开增值税专用发票) for profit, i.e., false invoicing, also forged invoices. This is typical crime of "虚开增值税专用发票罪" (crime of false invoicing, i.e., illegal issuance of false invoices). In Chinese criminal law, the crime is "虚开增值税专用发票罪" (or "虚开增值税专用发票罪" under article 205? Actually article 205 of Criminal Law: "虚开增值税专用发票罪". Also forging invoices is part of that. So the charge is "虚开增值税专用发票罪". In examples, they sometimes list "虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票;经济犯". But here it's just false invoicing for tax evasion. So answer: [罪名]虚开增值税专用发票罪<eoa>. Possibly also "伪造发票罪"? But Chinese law lumps forging invoices under same crime.
